title: v1.0 Foundation-Criteria Advisory (2026-06-05)
summary: Forensic audit finding current v1.0 criteria cannot certify a finished language; proposes FOUNDATION tier (CR-F1–F6) with machine-readable LLM-actionable format and gate ordering.
notes: Categorized as DOC (research audit and advisory) rather than SPEC because it proposes new tiers and format but does not represent currently-accepted, live gates. Implementation of CR-META format pending council adoption.
